liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Built To Last** (5 reviews, 1 other source): The standout moment is the transition from Playin' into Built to Last, which the reviewer finds distinctively Grateful Dead; Playin' flows directly into Built To Last as a true transition, not the band ending one tune and starting another [3][19][21][23][24][26]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review, 1 other source): The Scarlet-Fire jam is singled out as worth downloading for; Scarlet Begonias went into Fire On The Mountain and then returned to Scarlet Begonias [1][24]
- **The Other One** (2 reviews): Reviewer judges The Other One the best part of the night, ahead of Scarlet-Fire; With a subwoofer turned up, The Other One is so bassy it might break windows [16][22]
- **Playin' In The Band (Reprise)** (2 reviews): Reviewer loves closing the show with the Playin' reprise; The show ends with a Playin' reprise, followed by a Brokedown Palace encore [23][26]
- **Touch of Grey** (1 review): Touch is chipper, and its sound becomes fuller around the four-minute mark [27]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Reviewer hears Rooster as predatory howling [27]
- **Brown-Eyed Women** (1 review): Lyrics are forgotten and the playing is weak, yet the song evokes deep melancholy for the reviewer [27]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer praises the first-set Bird Song as a great one [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-04-06.111974.aud.dak5245-pzm.annarbor-mi.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 27 songs; 153 min [1]
- **gd1989-04-06.158252.MTX.photoLeon.t-flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 168 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1989-04-06.mtx.sirmick.85256.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 164 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd89-04-06.sbd.unknown.5492.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 159 min; rated 3.86/5 by 7 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard very juicy and full-sounding; Reviewer says both circulating versions sound excellent and finds no obvious difference between them [18][23]
- **gd1989-04-06.148148.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 161 min [6]
- **gd89-04-06.sbd-matrix.kowalski.1092.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 154 min; rated 4.15/5 by 13 [11]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the matrix recording has excellent sound quality; This version has great Phil in the mix, as good as many official Dead releases; Reviewer calls the Healy matrix mix killer [16][22][26]

## Around the show

- Band sounds tightly locked in from the start, with Brent especially strong [18]
- Reviewer attended both Crisler nights and calls the first night a normal, average show [22]
- This was the reviewer's first Dead show [24]
- Second of two nights at this basketball arena; uploader found the audience recording's sound pretty good for an arena [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-04-06.111974.aud.dak5245-pzm.annarbor-mi.flac16**: taped by Robert Mullen; transferred by Robert Mullen; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Transfer Date: 2011-02-17; Equipment/Lineage: 2 DAK 5245 Microphones and 2 Realistic PZM Mics(Mounted on 1'x 1'x 3/8"… [1]. Also: Audience recording made with DAK 5245 PZM microphones, one of several sources for this show [1]
- **gd1989-04-06.158252.MTX.photoLeon.t-flac16**: source: Matrix created in Adobe Audition by Joe Noel July 29, 2022 [3]. Also: Matrix combining a Ted Mattes recording with the Pearson and Healy soundboard, processed by Charlie Miler [3]
- **gd1989-04-06.mtx.sirmick.85256.sbeok.flac16**: source: Matrix by Sir Mick [4]. Also: Matrix from a cassette master on Tascam 122mkII, transferred at 24/48 then downsampled to 16/44.1; Brokedown Palace in this version comes from a B&K 4011 source [4]
- **gd89-04-06.sbd.unknown.5492.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard Cassette Master-> DAT-> CDR except encore which is from B&K 4011 source [5]
- **gd1989-04-06.148148.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [6]. Also: Two sets of masters were combined to make the show complete [6]
- **gd89-04-06.sbd-matrix.kowalski.1092.sbeok.shnf**: source: Healy Ultra Mix - sbd+aud> cm> dat> cd [11]. Also: On the matrix copy, the middle Playin' on disc 2 duplicates the reprise on disc 3 and can be deleted [17]
